experiment_template.research_question: Does marginal public-task/source coverage ordering improve archived-boundary evidence selection under unchanged packet and8K request limits?
stop_conditions: Exact source/receipt proof and immutable reviewed freeze before calls
Gold only isolated evaluator after all generation sealed
Native storage and provider health guards

records.falsifier: Any offered coverage regression, no strict improvement, native quality regression, missing outcome or unknown usage.
records.mechanism: Only candidate ordering changes; native source projection, schema, packet limits, shared archived prefix and GLM profile remain fixed.
records.scope: All eight exposed donor archives, paired component diagnosis; not full benchmark, discovery, whole-trajectory efficiency or untouched confirmation. Exact GLM-5.3-flash 8K component.
records.statement: Marginal lexical/source coverage preserves more useful delivered evidence and improves final selection within identical limits.
